components.name: structural defect diamond and premature-collapse debt
components.project_addition: For nested observation row modules U'<=U and target row modules W'<=W, identifies a canonical interaction module I=(U cap W)/((U' cap W)+(U cap W')) controlling both the extra observation-loss defect and the extra target-retirement benefit. The resulting four-point cross interaction mass is nonnegative. Interprets I as the exact p-adic debt of collapsing observation before the last use of target structure.
